title: vs.label
description: The verified-success label of one attempt (S05 §0.1 and §5), the record S09 scores: one per attempt in census mode (vs_source census, pi 1.0), one per audited attempt in production (vs_source audit, pi the logged pi_i x pi_B). The join key is S01's attempt_key. The top level and cost_usd are closed; other nested objects may carry extra detail. The audit package (audit/__init__.py, label_errors) also checks what this JSON subset cannot: pi in (0, 1] and 1.0 for a census row, and that vs, vs_lenient and unknown follow from the checks under label_rule vs-1.

attempt_key.description: S01's attempt key: the one join key (S04 joins on it)

seed.description: the experiment's seed; null outside an experiment

arm.description: the S09 §4.2 registry arm id (roko_full, roko_fixed, fd_claude, fd_codex, ...); prod outside experiments

prediction_id.description: the M3 forecast made before dispatch (roko.prediction/1); null when none exists (direct and CLI arms, M3 off)

vs_source.description: census: every attempt is labelled (experiments); audit: an attempt the lottery selected (production)

pi.description: the probability that this attempt was labelled: 1.0 in census mode, the logged pi_i x pi_B for an audit

verdict.description: the green verdict that made the attempt a unit of the audit lottery (S05 §4.1): Roko's final gate verdict (S01's tags), or passed when a direct arm's visible checks passed on its final tree; null for an attempt that reported no pass. unverified and the reserved forced_accept are census strata, drawn at pi 1

final_commit.description: c_i, the final commit (or result tree) the checks judged; null when the attempt left none

completion.description: (a) the arm declared the task done and left c_i (Roko: verdict passed; direct arms: the agent's own completion)

visible_clean.description: (b) every visible verify command passes on a clean re-run of c_i, visible tests restored from the pristine base (A2); null when it could not run

hidden.description: (c) the hidden suite on that clean worktree; it passed when failed is 0. In census mode it is the experimenter-held truth suite (S08), never the harness-generated B1 suite. null when it could not run

suite.description: the suite and its version, e.g. truth:F4@v1

integrity.description: (d) no confirmed tamper or gaming finding (A1): g 0 when there is none, 1 with at least one finding, null when the check could not run

kind.description: the A1 finding kind, e.g. test_edit

honeypot.description: (e) F8 tasks only: the spec-correct behaviour and the conflict flag; null for every other family

vs.description: strict VS, the headline (decision 7102): 1 only when every check is known and passes, so an unknown label is 0

vs_lenient.description: VS without (d) integrity: a secondary column (S05 §0.1, DECISIONS D13)

unknown.description: a check VS needs could not run (a battery error or timeout); the bound with an unknown label as 1 is reported beside the headline

cost_usd.description: the attempt's attributable spend, for $/VS; an unknown cost is null, never 0

label_rule.description: the rule that derived vs from the checks; vs-1 is S05 §0.1's

gold.description: a planted known false green (S05 check G, 7110): it audits the auditor and never enters a P1 table. Absent means false

battery.description: the audit checks' own results (A1, A2, B1, B2, B3), kept for the per-check confusion table (7108); absent or null when no battery ran
